title: May 2026
summary: Direction locked: watercolour, warmth, and Korean visual language throughout.

scenes.prose: The reference sheet earned its keep — called "quite apt" and kept as the compass for everything after.

asset.alt: A four-petal blush blossom with a mint centre, marking the direction reference being confirmed.

scenes.prose: Hanbok silhouettes, tassel and norigae ornament, the fox-spirit lineage — a visual vocabulary, not just a look.

asset.alt: A wood-brown branch with three buds, marking the visual vocabulary taking root.
